actions.label: Starnav ON
actions.description: STARNAV_ENABLE=1 - hand EK3_SRC1_*/GPS_PRIMARY/Q_RTL_MODE back to the Starnav switches and flight events. Sends MAV_CMD_DO_AUX_FUNCTION for SCRIPTING_6 (305) at switch position HIGH.

actions.label: Starnav OFF
actions.description: STARNAV_ENABLE=0 - restore the normal QuadPlane set (EK3_SRC1_POSXY/VELXY/VELZ=3, GPS_PRIMARY=0, Q_RTL_MODE=2) and go idle. Sends MAV_CMD_DO_AUX_FUNCTION for SCRIPTING_6 (305) at switch position LOW.
